title: Aegis Latent Core: a tamper-evident evidence chain for AI traffic. Does this help a blue team, or is it just another log source?
description: Aegis Latent Core is a tamper-evident evidence chain designed to secure AI interaction logs by hash-chaining and signing each event before delivery. It aims to help blue teams detect post-collection tampering of AI traffic logs, preserve forensic artifacts, and support compliance with AI traceability regulations. It does not prevent or detect endpoint compromise or guarantee client honesty, as it starts at the collector. The system is intended as an additional evidence layer rather than a SIEM replacement or producer attestation mechanism.
